# Recomp Achievements (rl-achievements SDK)

From https://github.com/elripalda/RecompAchievements at commit faf094acdf1efb57d8db7c8187b4b47aa1501805 (`sdk/`:
`include/`, `src/`, `third_party/`), unchanged. Recomp Achievements License 1.0 (`LICENSE`: free for any game); the
bundled rcheevos and cJSON keep their own MIT licenses (`third_party/rcheevos/LICENSE`, `third_party/cjson/LICENSE`).

MUA3 Recomp uses its events mode (`runtime/achievements.c`). Started outside RecompLauncher every call does nothing.
